tagline: More Tableau calculations in /importBI: Importing Tableau reports with the /importBI Genie Code command now supports more cases of parameterized calculations.
what_it_does: More Tableau calculations in /importBI: Importing Tableau reports with the /importBI Genie Code command now supports more cases of parameterized calculations. Relationship scoped filters (Public Preview): On a dashboard with relationships, each widget now responds only to filters whose dataset is related to it, so a filter no longer affects unrelated charts. Choose the warehouse for materialization: When you export a dashboard dataset as a materialized view in Unity Catalog, you can now choose which SQL warehouse runs the materialization.
why_it_matters: Metric view reuse when building: When building a dashboard, Genie Code now prefers governed metric views over ad hoc SQL datasets and reuses an existing metric view when one satisfies the request.
